name: Afforestation, Reforestation, and Revegetation
description: Quantifies net GHG removals from establishing woody vegetation on non-forest land, including biomass, dead wood, litter and soil carbon pools, against a baseline set with the methodology's dynamic performance benchmark.
formula: NER_t = (ΔC_PROJ,t − ΔC_BSL,t) − GHG_LK,t  (ΔC_PROJ includes above/below-ground biomass, dead wood, litter, SOC; project emissions netted out; stocks converted with 44/12)

parameters.name: Net GHG emission reductions/removals
parameters.description: Net benefit credited in monitoring period t

parameters.name: Project net carbon stock change
parameters.description: Net GHG removals (or emissions) in the with-project scenario

parameters.name: Baseline net carbon stock change
parameters.description: Net GHG removals (or emissions) in the baseline scenario

parameters.name: Leakage emissions
parameters.description: Emissions displaced outside the project boundary as a result of the activity

parameters.name: CO2-to-C molecular weight ratio
parameters.description: Converts carbon stock changes (tC) to CO2 equivalents

applicability: Afforestation, reforestation or revegetation (ARR) activities on eligible land
Baseline determined via the methodology's dynamic performance benchmark
Removals measured/estimated per carbon pool with stated uncertainty
sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0047 v1.1 (registry listing and Verra ICVCM announcements)

name: Reducing Emissions from Deforestation and Forest Degradation
description: Consolidated REDD+ methodology crediting avoided deforestation and degradation. Baseline activity data comes from jurisdictional maps of allocated deforestation risk (module VMD0055).
formula: NER_t = ER_BSL,t − ER_WPS,t − GHG_LK,t  (baseline vs with-project emissions from deforestation/degradation, minus leakage)

parameters.name: Net GHG emission reductions/removals
parameters.description: Net benefit credited in monitoring period t

parameters.name: Baseline emissions
parameters.description: Emissions from projected deforestation/degradation without the project

parameters.name: With-project emissions
parameters.description: Emissions from deforestation/degradation with the project

parameters.name: Leakage emissions
parameters.description: Emissions displaced outside the project boundary as a result of the activity

applicability: Avoided unplanned deforestation and forest degradation projects
Project baseline uses VMD0055-compliant jurisdictional deforestation-risk data
sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0048 v1.0; Verra Stakeholder Update Oct 2025

name: Improved Forest Management Methodology Using Dynamic Matched Baselines from National Forest Inventories
description: Credits improved forest management by comparing project forest carbon stocks against dynamic baselines built from matched plots in national forest inventories.
formula: NER_t = (ΔC_PROJ,t − ΔC_BSL,t) − GHG_LK,t  (baseline stock change taken from matched national-forest-inventory plots)

parameters.name: Net GHG emission reductions/removals
parameters.description: Net benefit credited in monitoring period t

parameters.name: Project net carbon stock change
parameters.description: Net GHG removals (or emissions) in the with-project scenario

parameters.name: Baseline net carbon stock change
parameters.description: Net GHG removals (or emissions) in the baseline scenario

parameters.name: Leakage emissions
parameters.description: Emissions displaced outside the project boundary as a result of the activity

parameters.name: CO2-to-C molecular weight ratio
parameters.description: Converts carbon stock changes (tC) to CO2 equivalents

applicability: Improved forest management (IFM) on managed forests
National forest inventory data available to build matched baselines
sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0045 v1.2 (Verra ICVCM announcement Aug 2025)

name: Methodology for Tidal Wetland and Seagrass Restoration
description: Quantifies GHG removals and avoided emissions from restoring tidal wetlands (e.g. mangroves, salt marsh) and seagrass, covering biomass and soil carbon plus CH4/N2O effects.
formula: NER_t = (GHG_BSL,t − GHG_WPS,t) − GHG_LK,t  (baseline minus with-project net emissions; removals count as negative emissions)

parameters.name: Net GHG emission reductions/removals
parameters.description: Net benefit credited in monitoring period t

parameters.name: Baseline net GHG emissions
parameters.description: Net emissions of the degraded/unrestored baseline

parameters.name: With-project net GHG emissions
parameters.description: Net emissions after restoration (negative when net sink)

parameters.name: Leakage emissions
parameters.description: Emissions displaced outside the project boundary as a result of the activity

applicability: Restoration of tidal wetlands and seagrass meadows
Includes creation, hydrological restoration and revegetation activities
sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0033 v2.1 (Verra digitalized methodologies list)

name: REDD+ Methodology Framework (REDD+MF)
description: Legacy modular framework for project-level REDD+ (avoided deforestation and degradation) with project-specific baselines. Newer projects generally use VM0048.
formula: ER_t = (ΔC_BSL,t − ΔC_PROJ,t) − GHG_LK,t  (avoided emissions relative to the modelled baseline)

parameters.name: Net emission reductions
parameters.description: Credited emission reductions in period t

parameters.name: Baseline net carbon stock change
parameters.description: Net GHG removals (or emissions) in the baseline scenario

parameters.name: Project net carbon stock change
parameters.description: Net GHG removals (or emissions) in the with-project scenario

parameters.name: Leakage emissions
parameters.description: Emissions displaced outside the project boundary as a result of the activity

applicability: Avoided unplanned or planned deforestation and degradation (via VCS modules)
Legacy pathway; see VM0048 for the consolidated methodology
sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0007 (summary; version not pinned)

name: Methodology for Improved Forest Management through Extension of Rotation Age
description: Credits additional carbon stored when the harvest rotation age is extended relative to the baseline harvesting schedule.
formula: ER_t = (C_PROJ,t − C_BSL,t) − GHG_LK,t  (long-term average carbon stocks, incl. harvested wood products)

parameters.name: Net emission reductions
parameters.description: Credited reductions in period t

parameters.name: Project carbon stock
parameters.description: Carbon stock under the extended rotation

parameters.name: Baseline carbon stock
parameters.description: Carbon stock under baseline rotation

parameters.name: Leakage emissions
parameters.description: Emissions displaced outside the project boundary as a result of the activity

applicability: Managed forests where rotation age is extended beyond the baseline rotation
Baseline harvesting must be documented
sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0003 v1.3 (VCS programme methodology list)

name: Improved Forest Management in Temperate and Boreal Forests (LtPF)
description: Credits avoided emissions where logged temperate or boreal forest is converted to protected forest.
formula: ER_t = (C_PROJ,t − C_BSL,t) − GHG_LK,t  (baseline includes logging emissions and wood product pools)

parameters.name: Net emission reductions
parameters.description: Credited reductions in period t

parameters.name: Project carbon stock
parameters.description: Stock in protected forest

parameters.name: Baseline carbon stock
parameters.description: Stock under continued logging

parameters.name: Leakage emissions
parameters.description: Emissions displaced outside the project boundary as a result of the activity

applicability: Conversion of logged forest to protected forest (LtPF)
Temperate and boreal forest types
sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0012 v1.2 (VCS programme methodology list)

name: Forest Land: biomass carbon stock change (gain-loss method)
description: Generic IPCC gain-loss approach for annual carbon stock change in forest land biomass, usable at Tier 1 with default growth rates and expansion factors.
formula: ΔC = ΔC_G − ΔC_L;  ΔC_G = Σ (A × G_TOTAL × CF);  G_TOTAL = Σ [G_W × (1 + R)];  ΔC_L = L_wood-removals + L_fuelwood + L_disturbance

parameters.name: Annual change in biomass carbon stock
parameters.description: Net change (gain minus loss)

parameters.name: Area
parameters.description: Area of forest land in the stratum

parameters.name: Above-ground biomass growth
parameters.description: Mean annual above-ground growth

parameters.name: Root-to-shoot ratio
parameters.description: Below-ground to above-ground biomass ratio

parameters.name: Carbon fraction of dry matter
parameters.description: Default 0.47 in IPCC Tier 1 for most forest types

parameters.name: Annual carbon loss
parameters.description: Wood removals, fuelwood and disturbance

applicability: Any forest land stratum with area and growth data (Tier 1 defaults available)
Guidance methodology, not a crediting programme
sourceRef: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National GHG Inventories, Vol.4 (AFOLU), Ch.2 and Ch.4
